thread:
ana_cs: Quick note from onboarding with Northbridge (CSM=Sam). They raised three asks that are blocking org-wide rollout: per-route spend caps, a small library of short-context embedding templates, and clearer per-route quota exports for finance.

leo_pm: Can you paste one example + how often they mentioned it? We need severity + whether it threatens renewal.

ana_cs: Example: Their analytics team ran a nightly batch and one route spiked $9k in charges. They mentioned the quota/export pain 3x this week. They said renewal "could be delayed" without a better view.

mira_support: Uploaded support thread and 30s console clip: https://support.example.com/NB-901. Workaround is client-side throttling which is brittle.

oscar_research: Quick priority note: spend caps = high impact, medium effort. Templates = low dev, high customer time saved. Exports = low effort, medium impact.

kevin_pdm: Please add 1-line descriptions so I can sketch PRDs. Flag any billing constraints.

ana_cs: spend caps: "Admins set soft/hard token or spend caps per route with alerts and override."
templates: "Ship 4 short-context embedding templates and README for common search/similarity patterns."
exports: "CSV export of monthly per-route tokens/spend and a dashboard countdown card."

leo_pm: Kevin/Oscar - t-shirt sizes by EOD? Mira attach artifacts to tickets. I'll create separate tickets per ask.

ticket-bot: Created RED-REQ-999 (route-caps), RED-REQ-1000 (embed-templates), RED-REQ-1001 (quota-exports). Linked NB-901.

mira_support: Attached clip + logs to all three tickets.

oscar_research: I'll run a quick count across tickets and drop numbers in /shared/cs/feedback/ tomorrow.

leo_pm: Next steps: I'll triage roadmap fit; Kevin to draft PRDs; Mira to attach all artifacts; Oscar to add frequency metrics. If Northbridge escalates, CSM will ask for a finance sync. Thanks.
